name: comp-335
title: Accordion Plus Minus
blurb: Accordion with plus/minus icon cycling through open/closed states.
description: Origin UI accordion. Plus icon (+) becomes minus (-) on expand. Emphasizes the open/closed duality visually.
use_when: FAQs or documentation where ± icons are more intuitive than rotation.
avoid_when: Accessibility concern: ± icons less standard than chevron rotation.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden. Button has aria-expanded.
